title: Yeasty Korean Radish Jjigae
description: A crispy, savory, and slightly sweet Korean dish featuring radish, perfect for a hearty brunch. Traditionally cooked in a clay pot over low heat, this recipe is shojin-friendly and easy to prepare.
instructions: Cut the radish into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the water and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until it becomes frothy.
Heat the vegetable oil in a clay pot over medium heat. Add the garlic and ginger and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the radish pieces and cook for 5 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the Korean chili flakes, sesame oil, sesame seeds, salt, and sugar. Mix well to combine.
Pour the yeast mixture into the pot and mix well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the radish is cooked through and the liquid has thickened slightly.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
